json-ld.name: Purple Lens
json-ld.description: Purple Lens is a cutting-edge web accessibility software solution designed for cross-platform websites. The innovative software has been designed to help users with disabilities to access web content that was previously unavailable to them. The SAAS product boasts a wide range of features such as voice functionality, color contrast, font size adjustment, and a virtual keyboard. With these features, Purple Lens makes it easier for users with disabilities such as visual, hearing or mobility impairments to navigate and interact with websites, improving their user experience. By implementing Purple Lens, website owners can enhance their website's accessibility and reach out to a broader audience, making their content available to hundreds of users who were previously unable to access it.
